description: This file defines a diagnostic analyzer class for Roslyn that detects methods with multiple CancellationToken parameters in Orleans code generation tools. It includes constants for diagnostic IDs, titles, messages, and a method to create diagnostics based on method symbols.

classes.name: MultipleCancellationTokenParametersDiagnostic
classes.description: A static class providing diagnostic rules and methods to create diagnostics related to multiple CancellationToken parameters in methods.

methods.name: CreateDiagnostic
methods.description: Creates a Diagnostic object indicating a method has multiple CancellationToken parameters, using the method symbol.
